infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Covariate reads camera-frame brightness metadata to measure ambient light. No photos or video are captured or stored.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Covariate measures ambient sound level as a single loudness number. Raw audio is never recorded or stored.

plugins.microphonePermission: Covariate measures ambient sound level as a single loudness number. Raw audio is never recorded or stored.
